notes.title: Patch Notes V1.2.70
notes.content:
Hey Typists,

We have released a small patch today addressing a few things: 


 Filtered some Words out of the English word bank
 Fixed a bug with Portuguese where the single letter Ç was not typeable
 In the level Touch, Type, Delicious - Added a message when planning a delivery route, telling the player to confirm his route by pressing enter.


Thanks everyone for keeping us updated with any bugs/issues within our Discord or Steam Forums, happy typing! 

- The Touch Type Tale Team

notes.title: Launching on November 4th!
notes.content:
📢 Hear ye, hear ye! 

The time has almost come for you to take up arms (and fingers), as Touch Type Tale will be launching on Steam on November 4th. Check out our brand new trailer below! 

[previewyoutube=6whVvqjzwYk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to brush up on your typing skills beforehand then head on over to our store page and play the free Demo - this includes 4 levels and 4 multiplayer maps. 

If you are checking out the demo, we are also running a giveaway to win a typewriter themed keyboard (from our partners QWERKYWRITER) and launch keys of Touch Type Tale. Playing the Demo gives you a greater chance of winning the grand prize, so don't forget to enter here.

Good luck, and we look forward to seeing your WPM and accuracy scores 👀


- The Touch Type Tale team ✨

notes.title: Clacky keyboards at the ready, it’s playtest time!
notes.content:
Hey touch typers! 

Want to test your strategy skills ahead of our Steam launch? We are pleased to announce that we are running a Touch Type Tale playtest live NOW until September 2nd.

In this playtest you’ll be able to brush up on your touch typing and strategic skills as you will have access to 4 single player missions as well as 4 online multiplayer maps. These are available in 5 difficulty levels and 13 languages. 


 English
 French
 Italian
 German
 Spanish - Spain
 Japanese
 Korean
 Polish
 Portuguese - Brazil
 Russian
 Simplified Chinese
 Spanish - Latin America
 Turkish


Another piece of info for our multilingual typists, you can type in one language and have the game/UI in another. So don’t forget to set your game up to suit your own language playstyle! 

Please note: this playtest also includes an online multiplayer feature, this is the first time we are able to test this on Steam. 

If you want to find a pal to jump into the game online with, we recommend checking out our Steam Discussion forums or Discord and putting out a call to arms. 

Don’t forget to wishlist on Steam to be notified of our pending release date, and we’ll see you in-game! 

- The Touch Type Tale team

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.6.4
notes.content:
Our very first patch notes are here:

- Fixed a bug where quitting the tutorial was unresponsive
- Fixed a bug which allowed upgrades to be bought multiple times
- Fixed a bug which sometimes summoned three instead of two units
  with a summon units spell
- Fixed a bug that would crash the game when finishing multiple
  words in a single frame
- Fixed a bug that would crash the game on saving a replay
  with characters not allowed for filenames.
